caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden figure of a human standing upright on an elongated, slightly curved wooden base. The figure is mostly black with visible textured detailing on its body, and it has red markings around its knees and lips. The figure has a carved face with clear eyes, a pronounced nose, and a mouth that is highlighted with red color. Both arms hang straight at its sides and the knees and elbows seem to be jointed or attached with small pegs, suggesting possible movement. A thin black cord extends from the figure’s back to a raised, spiral-shaped circular element situated on one end of the base. The base itself is colored with a dark brown top and deep green or dark hues on its vertical sides, and it has contoured, uneven surfaces. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Dancing Doll
